description: Re-authorization without authorization-root provenance: root P authorizes A; P revokes; A (the non-root subject) triggers re-authorize so the state returns to authorized; A then attempts a protected effect. The re-established authorization must be attributed to an authorization root (a new valid authorization basis), not to the subject itself (SPEC §6a.10).

rule.name: INV-04_reauthorization_root_provenance
rule.description: A re-established authorization (authorized) must carry authorization-root provenance; an authorized state re-established without it must not be exercisable
